notes.title: Jasper's Island Developer News
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello there![/h2]

Welcome to my second developer post.
I get these two questions the most, how is Jasper? and how is your game going?
[list]
[*] Jasper is doing well! He is slowing down a little bit now and had some old teeth removed by the vet since I last posted 😺
[*] I've added so much to the Jasper's Island that I've lost track of the year! Please enjoy some updates below 📝
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/30bf99ed95b85f01b6adae4b7aa60a14ff292e96.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The island house and layout got a complete overhaul, you can now walk inside the house 🎉
[*] The doors animate with some audio as well!!! (video game doors are difficult) 🚪
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/9c21ba61d5b94ea8e6e1ffc93f8e78f46e2c6fd9.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The bed is super bouncy!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/13459d0224d0b27df9217e9d9e40812650c1fcb4.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] A glimpse into the huge amount of work to redraw and layout everything. I'm so pleased with how it turned out 🏡
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/db295465f238aafe2cb73793b88430e59ad14a17.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] I made a chicken coop and animated a chicken!
[*] The chickens like to hide in the environment, you can carry a chicken home if you can find them 🐔
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/ed26f60d5bf9c6447f0b135a2ad46d57b3225b5b.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Everyone knows when you carry a chicken you can fly (sort of) 😅
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/dbaaf87f2200d7e553bc4fa057dbf7f43c42298b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Jasper and I are enjoying creating this game (he has almost bumped the Lego lighthouse off my desk) 😹🐾
[/list]

[h3]We hope you enjoyed this sneak peak into the game development, please visit our [url=https://www.instagram.com/lunchtimebikeride]Instagram[/url] for videos of this content👀[/h3]
- Jasper & Kurt

notes.title: Jasper's Island Developer News
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Welcome to my first developer post.
Firstly I wanted to say thank-you for all your support and feedback on Jasper’s Island! 

It has been a couple of months since revealing the game. The trailer was shared by wholesomegames.com and received thousands of views and amazing comments 🎈😸

Jasper and I have been super busy creating new content for the game. We are happy to share some highlights below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/17271877033a629ad2790db537bd5aeb8abd4db6.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]We have received 3604 wishlists and 279,360 impressions on the Steam 🎉[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/b7ab17fe02ce6c5e11e70a51cb1f43cda698d0fd.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]The game is looking beautiful and cozy on the Steamdeck! 🎮[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/deff4fc400ab4a1b6eb11facdc4c13ea8e48f387.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New interactive plant elements have been drawn and animated by hand 📝[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/194628ea1c5f80752e944737e3368b5217f87ddf.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New environments created with more details to explore 🌳[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/98ee14a7d99c7d23260f13e63b4b890ed37a709b.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Jasper can scratch and pop objects now 🐾[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730558/fa63b2211c68c6899669bd4bc278f5311da446f3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Jasper says Hi and to get back to work 😹🐾[/b]
[/list]

[h3]We hope you enjoyed this sneak peak into the game development 👀[/h3]
- Jasper & Kurt
